title: Multiple testing with the horseshoe
summary: We study multiple testing under continuous global--local shrinkage priors, with a focus on the horseshoe prior in high-dimensional sparse settings. While such priors provide adaptive shrinkage and computational scalability, they do not induce exact zeros and hence do not directly yield posterior inclusion probabilities, making principled false discovery control nontrivial.
